arStrings.szText:
Rushing Claw deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage and is empowered based on how many Charges it has when you Cast it:
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}1:{/c} Heals {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}2:{/c} Guaranteed to {c_important}{u}Overpower{/c}{/u}.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}3:{/c} Guaranteed to {c_important}Critically Strike{/c}.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}4+:{/c} Strikes an additional time.
{c_important}Rushing Claw deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage and is empowered based on how many Charges it has when you Cast it.
